description: Loose and distributed. Fires mostly in mid-game (ply 12-28) when the opponent owns row 4 of the centre column (cell (4,3)), the cell beside it (4,4) is empty, (3,4) is not mine and (5,3) is not theirs. Strongest when their last stone landed at (3,4). Many such boards still do not fire: the activation depends on much of the board and on move order.
effect: none measurable: forcing it to zero or to max changes move probabilities by at most ~0.07 (6 positions).
notes: Layer 3. Band-9 cell histograms: (4,3) theirs 85% vs ~20% at baseline; (4,4) empty ~100%; last move on row 3 in 57%. Dev F1: p1 core rule 0.24, hand cue count 0.31, core+ply 0.29, last-move rule 0.17, (4,3)-or-(3,4) 0.26, core AND >=5 cell cues 0.366 (best; sim share 0.19). Minimal pairs: filling (4,4) kills it; (4,3) theirs->mine roughly halves it; far stones and move order shift it by 2-3 units (same board 0.55-3.18). Looks distributed or like a mixture; no clean concept. Synthesis reaches 9.76 (dev max 7.19).
